result.title: MGE: A Membership Guided Data Extraction Attack against Diffusion Models
result.summary: Recently, diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image generation. However, their inherent memory properties introduce a potential safety risk of training data leakage, i.e., data extraction attack. To illustrate such risk, we propose a membership guided extraction (MGE) framework to effectively extract training data from a pre-trained diffusion model. Our core idea is to formulate the data extraction as a conditional generation, where the condition signal is from a membership inference classifier. To improve the success rate and efficiency of MGE, we propose adversarial gradient and parallel branch decoding. Our experiments on image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our MGE can extract hundreds of images, which shows that more attention should be paid to privacy-preserving of diffusion model.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 MGE 框架，利用成员推断分类器作为条件信号，将扩散模型的训练数据提取建模为条件生成，并结合对抗梯度与并行分支解码提升提取成功率与效率。
